newsitem.title: USA: Trico Marine to buy 8 vessels in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Trico Marine to buy 8 vessels in 1997.

text.p: Trico Marine Services Inc said Wednesday it signed two definitive deals to buy seven supply vessels and one utility vessel for $36.2 million in cash.

The first acquisition from Laborde Marine, consisting of five supply vessels and one utility vessel, is expected to close by early February 1997. It said Laborde will continue to serve the offshore service industry in the Gulf of Mexico.
The second transaction for two supply vessels is expected to close in the second quarter. The supplier was not identified and the Trico was not available for comment.
Both acquisitions will be financed under the company's credit facility.

The acquisitions bring Trico's fleet total to 73 vessels. The total includes 41 Gulf of Mexico supply vessels, up from 16 one year ago, making Trico the second largest owner and operator of supply vessels in the Gulf of Mexico.
